rulesets.title: Rational durations
rulesets.description: Exact note/rest durations as fractions of a semibreve, including dots and tuplets.

rulesets.title: Metre classification
rulesets.description: Simple/compound/irregular and duple/triple/quadruple/quintuple/septuple classification of time signatures.

rulesets.title: Grouping in simple time
rulesets.description: Beaming and rest-grouping conventions in simple time, including the half-bar rules in quadruple time and accepted alternatives.

rulesets.title: Grouping in compound time
rulesets.description: Beaming and rest-grouping conventions for dotted beats, including both accepted forms of a silent dotted-crotchet beat.

rulesets.title: Grouping in irregular time
rulesets.description: Grouping by the stated sub-groups (e.g. 3+2, 2+2+3) in 5/4, 7/4, 5/8, 7/8.

rulesets.title: Tuplets
rulesets.description: Triplets, duplets and irregular divisions: member durations and correct written values.

rulesets.title: Written pitch
rulesets.description: Letter name, alteration and octave are separate; spelling equality differs from enharmonic equality.

rulesets.title: Keyboard layout
rulesets.description: White/black key layout and the mapping between keys and spelt pitches.

rulesets.title: Clefs and staff positions
rulesets.description: Staff positions and ledger lines for treble, bass, alto and tenor clefs.

rulesets.title: Accidental state
rulesets.description: An accidental applies to its line/space for the rest of the bar, through ties over the bar-line, until cancelled.

rulesets.title: Key signatures
rulesets.description: Order and count of sharps/flats; placement per clef; relative keys.

rulesets.title: Major scales
rulesets.description: Tone/semitone pattern with one note per letter name.

rulesets.title: Harmonic minor
rulesets.description: Natural minor with raised 7th, same ascending and descending.

rulesets.title: Melodic minor
rulesets.description: Raised 6th and 7th ascending; key-signature notes descending.

rulesets.title: Chromatic scale
rulesets.description: All semitones; each line/space used at least once and at most twice; spelling policy.

rulesets.title: Scale degrees
rulesets.description: Degree numbers and technical names.

rulesets.title: Intervals
rulesets.description: Interval number and quality from written pitches, simple and compound, order-insensitive.

rulesets.title: Enharmonic equivalence
rulesets.description: Same sounding pitch, different spelling; tasks state whether spelling or sound is assessed.

rulesets.title: Triads
rulesets.description: Root-position triads on scale degrees; harmonic minor for chord work in minor keys.

rulesets.title: Chord function and inversion
rulesets.description: Chord identity from pitch content; inversion from the bass note, independent of upper-voice spacing.

rulesets.title: Cadences
rulesets.description: Perfect (V–I), plagal (IV–I), imperfect (I/ii/IV–V); chord must contain the melody note(s).

rulesets.title: Octave transposition
rulesets.description: Moving a melody exactly one octave, optionally into another clef, preserving spelling.

rulesets.title: Instrument transposition
rulesets.description: Written ↔ concert pitch for B♭ (M2), A (m3) and F (P5) instruments with key-signature change and accidental respelling.

rulesets.title: Ornament signs
rulesets.description: Recognition of trill, turn, upper/lower mordent, acciaccatura, appoggiatura and matching written-out patterns to signs.

rulesets.title: Terms and signs
rulesets.description: Controlled vocabulary of performance terms and signs per grade (list pending authoritative source).

rulesets.title: Instruments
rulesets.description: Controlled vocabulary of instruments, families, clefs, transpositions and sound production.

rulesets.title: Voices
rulesets.description: Voice types and ranges.

rulesets.title: Score observation
rulesets.description: Composite questions about an authored score; each sub-question delegates to a deterministic grader.

graders.title: Single choice
graders.description: Exactly one option id is correct; option sets are authored or generated with no duplicate meanings.

graders.title: Multiple choice set
graders.description: Answer must equal the set of correct option ids.

graders.title: Duration equivalence
graders.description: Compares total rational duration of the learner's notes/rests with the target; any combination of the permitted values is accepted unless the task restricts it.

graders.title: Bar completion and grouping
graders.description: Checks the bar sums to the time signature and that grouping follows the conventions; every grouping the conventions accept is accepted.

graders.title: Grouping correction
graders.description: Classifies each beam/rest/tie choice against the grouping rules; alternatives listed by the rules are accepted.

graders.title: Bar-line placement
graders.description: Bar-line positions must match cumulative durations for the given time signature.

graders.title: Time signature
graders.description: Derives the time signature from bar totals and beat grouping; generator rejects rhythms that fit more than one listed answer.

graders.title: Tuplet
graders.description: Checks tuplet number, written value and total duration; equivalent notations (e.g. a duplet written with a 2 or as dotted notes) are accepted where the task allows.

graders.title: Pitch spelling
graders.description: Compares letter and alteration (and octave when required) against a set of accepted spellings; enharmonic answers are rejected unless the task assesses sound only.

graders.title: Staff position
graders.description: Maps the clicked/typed staff position and accidental to a written pitch in the given clef.

graders.title: Keyboard key
graders.description: Maps a key press to the set of spellings it represents and applies the task's spelling policy.

graders.title: Accidental state
graders.description: Computes the sounding written pitch of a note from key signature, earlier accidentals in the bar and ties.

graders.title: Scale spelling
graders.description: Generates the reference scale from the key and form and compares spelt notes, direction and octave.

graders.title: Key signature
graders.description: Checks accidental set, order and per-clef placement.

graders.title: Scale degree
graders.description: Derives the degree number or technical name of a note in a key.

graders.title: Interval
graders.description: Derives number and quality from written pitches; accepts both compound numbering styles (12th / compound 5th); for build tasks, the written note must be spelt correctly.

graders.title: Chord function
graders.description: Identifies chord degree and inversion from pitch content and bass; any voicing with the right notes and bass is accepted.

graders.title: Cadence chord choice
graders.description: Each chosen chord must contain the marked melody note(s) and consecutive cadence chords must form a permitted cadence; every valid combination is accepted.

graders.title: Transposition
graders.description: Transposes the source by the stated interval and compares spelling, octave, clef and key signature.

graders.title: Chromatic scale
graders.description: Checks all twelve semitones in order, each letter used once or twice, and the task's accidental policy.

graders.title: Ornament sign
graders.description: Matches a written-out figure to its sign (accepting standard alternative signs) or a sign to its name.

graders.title: Composite score item
graders.description: A sequence of sub-questions about one authored score; each sub-question names its own deterministic grader.
